en: Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a European town with dense red and gray roofs and a prominent church with a tall spire in the right middle ground. Above the town, against a pale blue sky with clouds, a woman in early 20th‑century clothing appears to float or fly while holding an open umbrella and a handbag. German text is printed over the sky, and additional publisher information is printed along the left and right edges.
